source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting excessive industrial emissions in an air-quality report

1. Start with the monitoring records.
2.
completion:
Find the records of a sudden spike in pollutant levels, or a gradual increase of pollutant levels above baseline.
+ Make sure that the sudden spike or gradual increase is unusual for this facility to the point that it can be a red-flag. 
3. Take a look at the records right before this spike or increase to make sure that there were no abnormally high pollutant levels detected then.
+ If there were abnormally high pollutant levels detected before the increase in question:
  + We would rule out that increase as real, since it was just a continuation of the previous abnormally high emissions.
  + When we ruled this increase out, we would need to look forward to see if there's any other increase we can reasonably document.
+ Likewise, if there are abnormally high pollutant levels detected right after the increase in question:
  + We would also rule out that increase, as it's only part of an abnormally high pollutant emissions
